def solve(g,bg):
    from collections import deque
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    colors=set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg}
    for c in colors:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=min(i for i,_ in cells);re=max(i for i,_ in cells)
        cs=min(j for _,j in cells);ce=max(j for _,j in cells)
        # flood bg cells outside bbox (including those adjacent) to label exterior
        ext=set((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==bg and (i<rs or i>=re or j<cs or j>=ce))
        cur=deque(ext);vis=ext.copy()
        while cur:
            a,b=cur.popleft()
            for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                na,nb=a+da,b+db
                if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and (na,nb) not in vis and g[na][nb]==bg:
                    vis.add((na,nb));cur.append((na,nb))
        inner=[(i,j) for i in range(rs+1,re) for j in range(cs+1,ce) if g[i][j]==bg and (i,j) not in vis]
        fc=2 if len(inner)%2==0 else 7
        for i,j in inner: out[i][j]=fc
    return out
